title: How to Verify a Token Before Swapping on Jupiter or Any DEX
excerpt: A five-minute verification ritual that pairs perfectly with a SyNexus scan.
author: SyNexus Editorial
trustLine: Non-custodial · You sign every trade · Not financial advice.

blocks.text: Copy the full mint from SyNexus or the project's official channel — not a reposted screenshot.
Run Should I buy this? on SyNexus. Read Avoid, Watch, or OK and the listed reasons.
Open Solscan. Confirm holder distribution and recent large transfers.
Find official links from verified project accounts — beware lookalike domains.
If you still trade, size for total loss. Verification reduces mistakes; it does not remove them.
